references.text: The angel Gabriel is also mentioned in connection with Daniel, where he explains a vision.
The prophecy of a virgin who will give birth to a son, which can be seen as a precursor to the angel's message to Mary.
The angel brings good news, just as Gabriel brought the message about Jesus' birth.
The angel's revelation to Joseph concerning Jesus' birth, parallel to Gabriel revealing himself to Mary.
The angel Gabriel appears to Zechariah to announce the birth of John the Baptist, which is closely linked to the context in Luke 1:26.
